title: WHAT KIND OF PLACE IS THE KINGDOM OF GOD?
reading: The Kingdom of God is the place where heaven and earth, that is, the spiritual world and the physical world, are united. The people of God refer to the spirits who are in the spiritual world and to all humankind living on earth. On earth, when a nation is established, it is said that the people living within the territory of that nation are the people of that nation, and that the land within its borders is the territory of that nation. In the same way, the Kingdom of God is the one that has God at its center and takes as its territory all of heaven and earth, that is, the entire invisible world and visible world. And all the countless spirits who came to this earth, lived centered on God and departed, the people who currently live centered on God, and even the innumerable descendants who will exist in the future, all live as the people of the Kingdom of Heaven. Since this is a heavenly will that can never change for eternity, there is no one who can deny it. Therefore, you must take this will as your center and become people who take such an ideal as their center. And, because this is the greatest point of purpose for which all beings, in common, long, when it gradually appears, the universe will be able to be unified. Until now, God has also fought internally against Satan and, externally, has fought against evil people. However, this is not a reckless fight, nor is it a fight that violates the law. In other words, God never fights in a way that departs from heavenly laws and principles. Jesus Christ, likewise, did not wage a fight that departed from heavenly principles. Therefore, even when we must wage a universal fight in the Last Days, we must know the laws and principles of the heavenly order. Thus, we must become people who know how to fight with this earth as the center. Although you may not know it, Satan also cannot establish a reckless law or wage a fight that departs from the heavenly order. Therefore, when unshakable conditions are established and the fight against Satan is carried out, if the human being deviates from the will of God, Satan begins to make accusations. The fact that Jesus was able to comfort the heart of the Father, who is in the spiritual world, and also the fact that God was able to entrust Jesus with the four-thousand-year struggle against Satan, happened because Jesus and the Holy Spirit knew the inner heart and love of God better than anyone else. Since Jesus took responsibility for this spiritual struggle, and the physical struggle was entrusted to the saints on earth, we, who must take responsibility for this struggle, just as Jesus was able to establish the condition of victory in the struggle against Satan according to heavenly law, must also possess a shield of victory through which we can fight according to heavenly law. In order for us to present ourselves as representatives of the Kingdom of Heaven, there is a weapon that we must possess as soldiers of God. This weapon is not financial power nor authority, but rather the Word that God gives us in order to raise us to a position of glory equal to His. Therefore, you must possess this weapon of the Word and assimilate this Word as your own. Then, you must become ministers of the Gospel who can defeat Satan. If you do not possess the Word, you will not be able to become soldiers of God responsible for the cosmic struggle. If today you understand this situation of God, you cannot fail to possess the character that can stand as the vanguard in this cosmic struggle against Satan. You must place yourselves as beings of character who can comfort the inner heart of God and the inner heart of Jesus. In addition, you must establish all peoples in the place of historical restoration, go out and establish the nations before the Will, and, going even further, you must establish yourselves in a form that can appear in the name of all humankind and the countless saints.
questions: Can I explain the Kingdom of God?
What is different between the world I live in and the Kingdom of God?
How can I know that this physical world is connected to God’s spiritual world?
What must I possess in order to become a person of the Kingdom of God?
Am I participating in the struggle to create the Kingdom of God?
How can I fight against Satan and win?
Have I developed the character to practice the Word, that is, the Truth?

title: THE CENTER OF FAITH
reading: The center of the faith we desire must not be something that is carried away by some tendency or power of this world. Believing and following such existence is not the highest standard of faith that we desire. That kind of position is not an absolute position. Therefore, one’s recognition of God must be firm. And we must possess a certain faith, capable of saying: “I will go. I will go without wavering. The world that God desires is this kind of world. No other standard can exist.” Even if the years pass and death approaches, this faith must not change. When we are placed in a situation in which we cannot fulfill, we must have the faith to walk even if we die; even if it is a path that God desires; even if we have to die, we must go even to the enemy’s nation, reappear on earth, and cooperate. Therefore, you must clearly know the center and objective of faith. This is something transcendental. To live a life of faith is to live by distancing oneself from human desires. Therefore, in order to reach the standard of the absolute and definitive desire, the initial central standard of faith, which possesses absolute content, must be unchanging. Even if the four seasons of spring, summer, autumn, and winter change, and even if the environment changes within a year, more than the environment changing, you must develop under your own objective. You must develop under your own conviction. If your conviction is not firm, nothing can be accomplished. Everyone, what is each person’s awakening? It is determination. When you make this determination, what must you possess? Do you make a determination by trusting only in yourselves? It is something done by having an object and seeking the center. That is, through the center, you say: “I will do it,” and then act in that way. Saying “I will do it” is different from “I did it.” “I will do it” is connected to the future. This goes beyond temporality. Then, why must we do it? Because, depending on how someone responds to this question, the character of that person is manifested. Even the character of God appears when the value of the created beings that God created is recognized. At that moment, the value of God is decided. However, until now, that value has not been decided. Therefore, God came in search of the value of the created beings, centered on the mission called restoration. This is the providence of God’s salvation. (Volume 27, pp. 111, 112)
questions: Do I know what faith is?
Do I know the standard by which I must live in this world through faith?
Do I know what the center of faith that God desires is?
Has my determination, through faith, become capable of reaching the value of God?

title: PERFECTION OF CHARACTER
reading: You yourself are the problem. Therefore, you yourself can also become an enemy. If your mind and body do not become one, you will become enemies. What, after all, does the individual perfection you often speak of mean? In general terms, it means establishing faith in a vertical relationship between parent and child. Just as God loves us, we also must love God. Since love is established in a reciprocal relationship, the relationship of God as Father and us as children cannot be separated. Individual perfection begins from establishing a vertical relationship with God. Just as God loves you, it is natural that you also must love God. This is something fundamental and principal. If you serve God as the vertical center, you will receive love as sons and daughters of God, who is the Father. In the same way, if a tradition of mutual love is not established, the starting point of individual perfection cannot arise. You must know that only the perfection of the Portion of Responsibility is the path to the perfection of character. The reason why God, when looking at fallen human beings, cannot pour out love before them is because there still remains the process in which fallen human beings must, first of all, realize the perfection of character. God is the subject of True Love. Since God is the subject of love, only when there is a complete object can love be exchanged. What does the perfection of character mean? It means becoming a human being capable of fully fulfilling the Portion of Responsibility. In other words, it is a revolution of character, in which a person is restored to the state before the Fall and becomes someone with perfected character, capable of fulfilling the Human Portion of Responsibility. The perfection of character can be called individual perfection. When a human being is able to fulfill the Portion of Responsibility given to him, he can attain the perfection of character. At the same time, he will be able to stand in the position of a son or daughter who can fulfill the desire of the Heavenly Parents, the Heavenly Parents who have hope before God. You must clearly know that, after the perfection of character, you will be able to possess True Love. If you do not know with certainty that, after the perfection of character, you can possess True Love, you must keep in mind that there is no place to remain on any other path besides the path of the perfection of character. (Blessed Family and Ideal Kingdom, p. 315)
questions: Can I know the heart of God?
Why is God Father to me?
Is individual perfection close to me, or is it still far away?
What is my Portion of Responsibility as I walk toward the Heavenly Parents?

title: THE WORLD OF HEART
reading:
What we call the spiritual mind is when the mind and the spirit unite and move once again toward a new purpose. It is a motivational mind that can form an ideal self, taking God as the center, united with the conscience, and taking the spiritual self as the center. Therefore, without this spiritual mind, the conclusion is that one cannot find the root of one’s own being, capable of relating with the Spiritual World and with True Love. When the spiritual mind arises within me, the body rejoices, and everything follows it. Automatically, it becomes a unified standard. The problem has always been that the body was not united with the mind. When spiritual power enters me and becomes the very source of vital energy, the mind and body naturally become one. From this root, a revolution takes place; and unless we discover the origin determined by that root, there will be no path for us to seek the ideal. There must be motivation for the result to appear. (91-143)

Who could have imagined that the apostles would place themselves, before Jesus, in the position of antichrists? And who could have imagined that the chosen people of Israel and Judaism would become antichrists? Even in the Last Days, we must be concerned about this. You must look at yourselves and be concerned whether, perhaps, you are not in the position of antichrists. Now is not the time to criticize others or interfere in the affairs of others. The problem is you yourself. It is not the problem of the church. We must be concerned that, in the Last Days, we ourselves may be dragged away by Satan. Until now, all the people who became a problem went through the historical process of losing themselves. Do you wish to joyfully receive the resurrection of glory, which is greater than the dawn, on the high mountain? Then you must feel the heart of Jesus, shed tears together with him, and take responsibility together with him. This is because only such a person can receive the resurrection of glory. (2-277p)

In the end, we must go to the Spiritual World. It is said that this is the world after death, but it is not the world after death. Why is it not the world after death? Because it is a world related to True Love; it is not the world after death. Since it begins with True Love as its center, when I stand in the position of True Love, it will not be a matter of now using the physical body and then dying; dreams connect directly to the Spiritual World. Therefore, True Love must come. Because all distances between the heavenly world and the earthly world are filled, and because we can experience this within the sphere of life of shared value, it is called the Spiritual World. It can also be said that it is possible to go to and return from the world after death. (290-51)
questions: Let us think about the mind, the spiritual mind, consciousness, and the original mind.
Is my consciousness united with God?
In life, does my thought come first, or do I first make an effort to establish a consciousness centered on God?
Has my heart already experienced becoming united with God’s love and crossing the dividing line between the Spiritual World and the physical world?

title: THE MIND IS THE SECOND GOD
reading: The conscience is the second God. The first God is positive, and the mind is negative, being the second God. You must have this concept. The mind is the second God. The second God is always with me. On the profound path of conscience, on the profound path of love, life, and lineage, it is relating with me. It organizes, gathers, and removes all things, constantly guiding me to a higher position. Therefore, the original conscience is always rising. This power governs the flesh. It becomes one with the positive and the negative, automatically unites, and is perfected. My conscience is the second God, and this powerful force always governs all things centered on God. Your mind does not need a teacher. The mind is the second God. Do not follow a teacher, but serve your own mind. What is the mind like? At dawn, when you wake up alone, without hearing even the sound of rats or flies, in silence, and you say: “Ah, I need to do what I was planning. I need to do something good,” then the mind says: “Great! Great! Do it right away!” But when you have an evil thought, the mind says: “Hey, you!” The mind is like this. The mind knows well. The mind becomes your teacher, protecting you night and day, and constantly tells you to do good: “Do good things. Do good things!” Then, how could it not become tired? From the day you began to have conscience, you acquired intelligence to analyze all institutions in the social environment, and throughout life, the mind accompanies you without even being able to follow its own teacher, which is itself. Since the mind is like this, in relation to me, it gives orders with reference to the will of the owners of all things. It says: “Resemble God, resemble a saint, resemble a patriot, resemble a filial child.” It always says to the body: “Body, you must resemble me!” You do not know that there is a great teacher within yourselves. The mind exists in the place of a great mother and a great father. There is no teaching given by mother and father. When the mind teaches together with mother and father, you must know how to obey. Within all these environments of order, no moral conclusion has yet appeared that can serve as the base. That formula has not yet appeared. The mind stands in the place of the teacher, in the place of the parents, and in the place of God. Therefore, there is no teacher who can teach the mind. The mind is better than God. The mind existed even before I existed. It is better than God, better than the parents, and even better than kings. That is why the mind is necessary. When someone tries to do something evil, is there any voice of the mind saying: “Go ahead, do it”? When you try to do something evil, the mind says: “Hey, you, do not do that!” You must absolutely listen to the word of the conscience. If you are created in this way, the conscience will say: “You and I.” When we pray, we must pray while holding firmly to the mind. How much have we done according to the will of the mind? We must place the mind above ourselves and call God Father; only then does it communicate. It is God who communicates when we are united with the mind. Therefore, we must think centered on the order of the mind. We must always ask the mind and consult it. Instead of asking our parents, we must ask the eternal conscience. The conscience is ahead of the parents. It may separate from the parents, but it cannot separate from the conscience. It may separate from the teacher, but it cannot separate from the conscience. It may separate from the king of the nation, but it cannot separate from the conscience. It may separate from the Lord, but it cannot separate from the conscience. To ignore the mind that lives serving these three great subjects is a tremendous sin. It is to ignore the parents, to ignore the teacher, and to ignore God, the Lord of the universe. We must have time to enjoy being with the mind. Seen from the world, it may seem like a lonely place, but it is the time to become a friend of the mind. It is to sit down and, even if it is meditation, try to do it. It is to enter a place of deep prayer. Without others knowing, it is to enter a profound world. This is necessary.
questions: Do I feel that my conscience is united with God and that God is within my mind?
In my life, am I completely following the order of the conscience?
Is the mind united with God governing my flesh?
Am I praying while holding firmly to the mind, or am I praying while holding firmly to the flesh?
When I pray, can I hold firmly to my mind without various other distracting thoughts?

title: HEART AND CREATION
reading: The center of love will be God. God is the unique, eternal, and unchanging Being who existed even before the formation of the universe. However, love is the flow of heart. The inner heart flowing outwardly is love. Therefore, the essence of God is heart. This God was precisely the unified being who, substantially, was the cause and source of the formation of another universe. The formation of the universe from this fundamental cause is precisely the re-creation of the flow of God’s creation of the universe, without there even needing to be such a necessity. But how was God able to create the cosmos and the human being? It was because God possessed heart. Only where there is heart can life appear; and where there is life, the movement of development takes place — that is creation. However, in this creation, there is necessarily a purpose, because the reason for this is that heart, by nature, points toward a purpose. Therefore, the purpose of creation can be nothing other than the joy of satisfying the heart. And this joy comes when the creature, especially the human being, comes to resemble God. Therefore, the objective that God wished to create was the human being and the nation that resemble God’s love and creativity. This can also be understood when we observe that the human ideal seeks this. Naturally, the ideal is the longing to seek the world that should be enjoyed. (Vol. 65, p. 258)
questions: Does my love move centered on what is mine, or centered on the heart of God?
What is God’s heart, and where is it?
Let us think about the purpose for which God created me.
Can I feel the heart of God directed toward me?
Let us feel the heart of God directed toward this world.

title: HOW CAN WE KNOW THE HEART OF GOD?
reading:
The question is how you will deeply experience the heart of True Parents, the love of God, and that heart, and how you will enter that state. For this, you must become Adam and Eve who did not fall. Satan must not be able to make accusations. Then, how will you be liberated from the satanic world? You must fight against Satan and overcome him. For this, how much effort and suffering will be necessary? Jacob was also deceived ten times, Moses was also deceived ten times, and Jesus Christ was also deceived in this way. It was the same with me as well. It is necessary to overcome this. At that moment, you come to know the heart of God. You come to know the heart of the Parents. Otherwise, you will never know. Without this, Satan will not withdraw. As long as you cannot overcome before Satan, you cannot know the heart of the Parents nor know the heart of God. (125-206, 1983.03.20)

In order to know the heart of the Parents, the great question is how you feel everything as one. And before overcoming Satan, this can never happen. This does not come. Therefore, I prepared the power plant and the transmission station. I prepared this tower on the individual, family, tribal, people, national, worldwide, cosmic levels, and even up to God. Therefore, now you must walk along the front line of the heart. This is not something I do, nor something God does for you. You must do it. (125-207, 1983.03.20)
questions: At present, am I closer to God or closer to Satan?
Let us think about what I must overcome by fighting against Satan in order to go all the way to God.
Let us remember the heart of God that I experienced from the standard of victory achieved through the fulfillment of the objective.
Let us share the heart of joy, anger, sadness, and pleasure of God and True Parents.

title: BECOME A 90-DEGREE ANGLE
reading:
When one becomes a 90-degree angle with God as the center, it is not Satan’s sphere, because Satan cannot dominate it. What will happen to the earth now? When everything that has moved through the first, second, and third Israels proclaims the name of True Parents, that entire sphere will become the Garden of Eden, and the entire history of religions will disappear. Therefore, the spirits in the angelic world will be able to go to this place at any time. Therefore, they will be able to return at any time. In other words, this is the sphere of ownership rights of the result of the Principle. Because heaven, earth, and the axis are all united, everything becomes equal to the Spiritual World. When the True Parents are proclaimed, this Reciprocal Base connects once again, and Satan disappears. Therefore, one can move freely. This is vertical, and that is horizontal; this angle is 90 degrees. Ninety degrees means that it is not Satan’s sphere. When the angle changes, the fallen world appears. Only in the place that becomes a 90-degree angle can God have dominion. There, there is no Satan. It is liberation. The Spiritual World is liberation, the earth is liberation, and all created beings are liberation. There are not even accusations there. (Vol. 202, p. 35)

You must be bold. This means that you must possess the subjective right of ownership. No matter how difficult an environment you may be in, there can be no problem. God also does not desire that kind of thing. If you say, “Disappear from before me!” it disappears immediately. The Spiritual World is the same. If I say, “I do not want this,” it disappears immediately. Around everything, there exists this kind of force. When the center of love appears, everything begins to turn toward that center. When the morning sun rises in the east, all the centers of the trees, plants, mountains, and rivers turn toward that sun, do they not? This is the essence of life, the essence of love. The Word. (Vol. 202, p. 357)
questions: In my life, what is the sphere that Satan is dominating?
How is Satan tempting and attacking me?
Let us organize which parts are united with God at a 90-degree angle.
Can I free myself from Satan’s temptations and dominion and enter the place of liberation where I serve God?

title: ABSOLUTE OBEDIENCE TO REMOVE EVIL
reading:
When one obeys absolutely and becomes one with the subject, evil can be removed. In the course of the restoration of Canaan, we must follow Father. When wild geese cross the ocean, there is absolute obedience before the lead goose. There is no objection. If it says, “You!” they fly. Even if it is difficult, they must simply follow it until death. Until now, we have done this kind of thing. Now we have reached the destination, we have sons and daughters, and everything has become simple; therefore, now, among you, you must serve one another, love one another, form one united tribe, and do that through which you can love that tribe itself. This is what must be done now, at this moment. Until now, it was the time to move toward the restoration of Canaan; now we have entered the era of settlement. (Vol. 115, p. 64)

Obey absolutely. To obey absolutely does not mean to ruin oneself. After obeying, what happens? One becomes one. After becoming one, what happens? Evil is revealed. Because one is completely united, evil is revealed. Therefore, evil can be removed. This is the Principle. (Collected Words, Vol. 57, p. 83)
questions: Personally, am I in the era of restoration or in the era of settlement?
Why must I obey in the life of faith?
What is the difference between obedience and absolute obedience?
Is there a way to separate Satan without practicing absolute obedience?
Let us think about the path to remove the evil and Satan that exist within me.

title: FILIAL CHILDREN, LOYAL PATRIOTS, SAINTS, AND DIVINE SONS AND DAUGHTERS
reading:
The predestined course of human beings is to go the path of filial children, loyal patriots, saints, and divine sons and daughters, in the relationship of parent and child with God. Those who have completely harmonized before the Will of Heaven, who have received Heaven’s recognition and had a mysterious experience, will know. At the same time that they feel God recognizing them, saying, “You are mine,” they will see that all created beings bow before them. Today, human beings do not know that, on the day when all created beings recognize that one is a child of God, not only the countless spirits in the Spiritual World, but also the creatures on earth, will bow before that person and serve him. When a person comes to occupy the position recognized by God and recognized by creation, even those who naturally possess a true conscience harmonize before that person. Then, what must you do in order to become God’s possession? First, you must feel that God, the Creator who made all these things, is truly our Father. Therefore, you must know that God, the Creator, is our Father, and that, as the absolute, eternal, and unchanging Being, He has been working from the time of creation until now in order to restore the relationship of parent and child, which could not be broken even if one wished to break it. (Vol. 4, pp. 102–103)

What God desired for Adam and Eve, His children, was that they grow and become filial children, loyal patriots, saints, and divine sons and daughters. Have you ever thought about how God desires that you become filial children in the family, loyal patriots in the nation, saints in the world, and divine sons and daughters before Heaven and Earth? Historically, all saints taught people to become filial children, loyal patriots, saints, and divine sons and daughters. A religion that cannot teach this cannot surpass, as a religion, a history of ten million years. In any case, this is the predestined course of human beings that we must follow. Predestination means something like the relationship of parent and child. One cannot escape predestination. Luck may create conditions that make it pass by, but predestination cannot be like that. Without knowing this content, one cannot fulfill the role of true parents in the family. True parents must teach complete things, such as becoming a filial child, a loyal patriot, a saint, and a divine son or daughter. They must teach their own children to fulfill the path of filial children, loyal patriots, saints, and divine sons and daughters, and furthermore, to go all the way to God. (Vol. 287, p. 23)
questions: What kind of state must I reach in order to become a child of God?
What is my position before God: servant of servants, servant, adopted child, or child?
Have I felt God as “my own God”?
Am I connected to God through predestination?

title: THE MIND IS MY LORD, MY TEACHER
reading: Just as the body resembles the mind from which it was born, the mind is the root of my body. Therefore, in plain terms, the mind is in the position of mother and father. The mind is in the place of the parents, in the place of the teacher, and in the place of the lord. Have you ever thought about how precious the mind within you is? When the body tries to go to a wrong place, the mind always rings the alarm bell and rebukes it, saying: “This must not be so!” However, the body always attacks the mind, ignores it, tramples upon it, and does as it wishes. Even when it is persecuted, until the moment of death, the mind that is within me continues as a companion in war and as a teacher, taking on a subjective mission and following the path of sacrifice for the sake of the body. When seeing a person for the first time, the mind generally already knows what that person is like. It already knows. The closest teacher is one’s own mind. Therefore, do not make that mind suffer or leave it sorrowful. This is to sadden the teacher and to sadden the lord of the cosmos. The mind is the lord of my entire life. Therefore, to sadden the mind is to sadden the lord of my entire life. We must follow the path through which the mind can rejoice. Your mind is ahead of your parents and ahead of your teacher. This mind is eternally united with you. However, your parents are not eternally united with you, your teacher is not eternally united with you, and your lord is not eternally united with you. Therefore, the mind possesses tremendous value. For this reason, before asking your parents, you must consult your mind. Then there will be no need to ask. This is because it is directly connected to God; therefore, if you enter into resonance and ask what the body desires, the answer will come immediately, for the frequency is the same. If you ask your mind: “Tomorrow I am going to meet such and such a person; what do you think?” it will tell you whether it is joyful or not. If you are going to meet that person, the mind knows whether it is good or bad. If it does not like it, the mind withdraws. (Cheon Seong Gyeong, Book 4, Chapter 1, Section 2, Item 17)
questions: Is my lord the physical body, which takes the body as its center, or the spiritual mind, which takes the mind as its center?
Does my body follow my mind, or does my mind follow my physical body every day?
Today, is my mind happier, or was my body happier?
Let us think about an experience in which my mind united with God and transcended reality.

title: THE ORIGINAL PALACE OF LOVE
reading:
Without the original palace of love, life, lineage, and conscience, there is not even a nation, nor the origin and development of the ideal world. Why did the reproductive organ come into being? That is the question. It came into being because of love, because of life, because of lineage, and because of conscience. If we do not pass through that place, there is no love, no life, no lineage, and no conscience. When God created the human being, would it have been difficult to create the five sensory organs, such as the eyes, nose, and others? Or would it have been difficult to create the reproductive organ? Are the five sensory organs the place where love is harmonized? Is that where love, life, lineage, and conscience are gathered together? No. Somehow, if there is only one such place, it is the reproductive organ. There the second fruits of love, life, lineage, and conscience are established, and we call them sons and daughters. Without this, nothing can exist. The entire created world becomes blocked. Until now, humanity has not known such a precious reproductive organ. Perhaps they have thought with pride: “I am the best in the world!” But without the reproductive organ, this is nothing. The reproductive organ refers to the true reproductive organ. (281-189)

Where does true love arise from? It arises in that place, where sons and daughters, the sons and daughters of God, are born. That is the reproductive organ. This has received the worst contempt. Heaven and earth are inverted, and it has been treated as something most shameful; however, in the restored Heaven, this is the original palace of love, the original palace of life, the original palace of lineage, and the original palace of conscience. People did not know the fact that, without this, neither the nation would arise, nor would there be development or origin of the ideal world. (Volume 286, p. 170)

The woman’s reproductive organ is the original cosmic root. The place where the relationship of love is established becomes the original palace of love. It is the central palace of origin. Love begins from there. The love of the first night of marriage is the starting point of the original palace of love. The life of the woman and the life of the man become one for the first time. Therefore, the original palace of ideal life is that place; and since lineage begins from there, the original palace of lineage is that place. And, just as the Kingdom of Heaven begins from there, this is the original palace of the Kingdom of Heaven on earth, the original palace of the Kingdom of Heaven in heaven, the original palace of human perfection, and the original palace of God’s perfection. (Volume 257, p. 324)
questions: Let us think about the essence of love.
Let us think about why the act of wrong love generated original sin.
Who is the owner of the original palace of my love?
How are love and True Love different?

title: THE STANDARD OF THE COURSE OF LIFE
reading: Here, “life” refers to eternal life. It does not refer only to the Spiritual World. It is the eternal life that is alive. The existence called “I” was created as the object of God’s love. I am precisely God’s absolute object partner. In other words, I am the object of God’s love. The concept of True Love is that God regards someone as more precious than Himself. God is the center of absolute and eternal life. And God’s ideal is even more eternal, and the center of that ideal is precisely True Love. The object of that love is me. The nature of love is that subject and object become one. This causes a nation to become one. Therefore, one can accompany any position and follow wherever one may go. One can inherit all property. One can even inherit the entire depth of God’s heart. By passing through the process I have described and, in this way, discovering this, the world was established upon this foundation. This is something that nothing can change; it is solemn and precious. It is an astonishing grace. Therefore, you will be in a position equal to that of God. You will be accompanying the position of true and eternal love. That world is of a dimension different from the limited Earth. In a limited place, one cannot move freely; but that world, being a world of a higher dimension, is a place where one can do anything. One can transcend time. If, centered on love, you simply desire anything, you will be able to obtain everything, at any time and in any place. We were originally created as beings of substantial image. The “I,” which is an object body centered on True Love, is a body of eternal life. Therefore, when one goes to the Spiritual World, there is freedom. For this reason, the first standard based on the Course of Life is the standard of good and evil. You must know this. The first is the standard of good and evil, the second is the original starting point, and the third is eternal life. (216- 115, 1991.3.9)
questions: Who am I?
Do I believe in the Spiritual World, or do I know the Spiritual World?
Have I experienced God? What must I do in order to find God?
What is the standard of life that I must establish from now on?

title: THE KINGDOM OF HEART OF THE FALLEN WORLD
reading: In Satan’s world, there is no connection with the Kingdom of Heart. In your case as well, in the same way, only after passing through a revolution of character will you be able to connect with true love. You must engrave in your heart that, as long as you do not free yourselves from self-centered, selfish thoughts, worldly ambitions, attachment to children, and a cultural sense of superiority that you enjoy, you will never be able to reach perfection. In order for Adam and Eve to mature as people of character, they should have centered on a perfect ideal religion, denied all things of Satan’s world, and begun anew. Therefore, even while receiving much persecution, I have denied worldly things in order to remain in a perfect position. All people who think about life centered on themselves are those who remain under Satan’s dominion. If you inherit the Kingdom of God’s Heart and reach the standard of perfection of character, then you will be in harmony both with the standard of God’s character and with the standard of perfected Adam’s character. We must become people who have reached the perfection of character, in conformity with the original standard of the perfection of character. For this, we must renew ourselves and perfect the Portion of Responsibility given to us. At this point, what can be stated categorically is that, nowhere in this world is there a place where someone can renew themselves and perfect their character; if there is such a place, it is only the Unification Church. In order to improve the world, if there is not 100% perfection of character, the standard of joy can never be reached. This is because, no matter how much it is said that a fallen human being has been saved, one cannot say that this person no longer carries the concept of the Fall, nor that God carries the concept that the human being fell. In order to eliminate even the concept of the Fall, one must become a finished product of more than 100%. (Blessed Family and the Ideal Kingdom of Heaven, p. 316)
questions: Where did my heart come from? Did it come from God?
Does Satan also have a heart? If so, what relationship does he have with my heart?
When I perfect my character, how will this connect to the original Kingdom of Heart?
Is it possible for me to reach the perfection of character? If it is possible, let us think about what I must do and how I must do it.

title: THE MEANING OF THE CONCLUSION OF THE PROVIDENCE OF RESTORATION
reading: What is the purpose of the coming of the Messiah? It is to destroy Satan’s sovereignty, bring humanity to Heaven’s side, expel Satan, and, by uniting with today’s Christianity, conclude the providence of salvation. This is the purpose of the coming of the Messiah. In other words, completing the providence of restoration in order to return to the world of God’s original Will is the mission of the Messiah. The Lord of the Second Advent comes to conclude the root of God’s providence of restoration, which Jesus could not conclude. In other words, He comes as the baby of the true original nature who will complete the ideal of creation, and He comes to complete the ideal of True Parents, who become the root of God’s True Love, True Life, and True Lineage. He already comes upon the foundation of the fundamental providence, in which God’s side had been victorious up to the time of Jesus. That is, He stands directly upon the victorious foundation that Jesus established and fulfills what Jesus could not fulfill: finding the bride, becoming the True Parents, and saving all peoples. (Cheon Seong Gyeong, Book 1, Chapter 4, Section 3, Item 2)
questions: Am I correctly understanding the providence of restoration?
Let us organize the relationship between the conclusion of the providence of salvation and the role and mission of the Messiah/Lord of the Second Advent.
Let us think about the relationship between God and True Parents.
What kind of relationship do I have with True Parents?

title: INDIVIDUAL SALVATION
reading: Originally, the bodies of Adam and Eve, who had not fallen, were the house where God could dwell. If Adam and Eve had taken God as the center of their hearts and, centered on True Love, had become eternally united as one body of love, one body of life, and one body of lineage, today our heart and our body would not be fighting with each other. The Fall means having inherited, centered on the love of the devil, the body of life and the lineage of the devil. We were born from false parents. Therefore, the lineage must be transformed. This means that the wild olive tree must be transformed into the true olive tree. For this, when it is grafted and, after passing through three generations or more, the fruit that ripens comes to represent the original standard, then the fallen human being will be restored as an original human being. At that moment, the providence of salvation will be completed. Thus, in order for us to become sons and daughters of good parents, centered on love aligned with God, God sends True Parents as the Savior. The Savior is the one who comes to purify the lineage of humanity and realize the original ideal of creation. (298-315~316, 1999.1.17)
questions: Let us organize the original state of the human being who has perfected their individuality.
What is the concrete path to transform the false lineage, caused by the Fall, into God’s lineage?
How will the conclusion of the salvation that the Savior must fulfill and the perfect realization of the original ideal of creation be accomplished?
What is the path of salvation that I must follow, and what is the path of perfection?

title: BECOMING CHILDREN OF GOD
reading: Then, what kind of heart is a good heart? It is a heart full of affection, seeking to embrace every person. When we see the difficulties of others, having a heart of sympathy is goodness. When justice is manifested and a heart arises that seeks to cover everything with affection, that is goodness. The heart that can embrace with affection even the tears that flow — the foundation of that heart is goodness. However, because of the Fall, this kind of heart completely collapsed. We must become an “I” whose body can respond based on a heart capable of embracing all Heaven and Earth. To have a joyful heart, to cry out with complete satisfaction, and, when something is undoubtedly good, to live a life capable of satisfying it and making it worldwide — this is the life of goodness. Even in the lowest position, the person who knows how to be satisfied is a happy person. Human beings cannot create even a single blade of grass by the roadside. What we all desire is to become sons and daughters of God. The only path to becoming sons and daughters of God is to live with goodness, having the conviction that we will move forward even if the whole world opposes us. Then the world will be conquered. The secret to becoming sons and daughters of God is to obey and submit to orders. God also desires to make you His sons and daughters, and you also desire to become sons and daughters of God; however, for this to happen, one must inevitably accompany the pain of childbirth. Effort and suffering are necessary. We are on the side of being formed; therefore, we must place ourselves unconditionally on the side of the One who desires to form us. (Vol. 12, pp. 288– 289)
questions: Is there any standard that determines the moment when there is joy and the state in which there is no joy?
Can I distinguish good and evil? If I can, what is that standard?
Is there any principle of life by which I can remain as a good person?
If there were three practical actions in life for me to become a child of God, what would they be?

title: WE MUST LIVE CENTERED ON TRADITION
reading: We must pass on to our sons and daughters the tradition that one must live in this way. The fact that you went to various countries and lived there, struggling with difficulties so that, in the future, you may leave a tradition before your descendants — this is an excellent, unique, and unrepeatable period, in which you will be able to say to your children: “We worked in the midst of these difficulties,” educate them, and leave them a legacy with traditional materials. Therefore, tradition is the central issue. This cannot be changed. It is an eternal tradition. An eternal tradition. We are people who must harmonize the world; therefore, white people and black people must become one body. What does this mean? It means returning to the sphere of brotherhood of unfallen humanity, of Adam and Eve. Then, what was the basic thought for establishing such a tradition? It was to live for the sake of others. From that point, your sons and daughters will grow without suffering in that kind of environment and will be able to go directly toward the Kingdom of Heaven, becoming descendants directly connected to Heaven, possessing a realm of substantial achievements capable of overcoming Satan’s world. After that, these brothers and sisters will marry. For us, marriage is transnational. If it is with a black person, it must be done; if it is with a white person, it must be done; if it is with a yellow person, it must be done. We have entered the realm in which this becomes possible. This tradition must be established from now on. At present, it has not yet been established. From now on, we must create it. When things become this way, with these traditional materials you must guide your descendants and the world. Instead, the two must become one. One must not simply give birth to sons and daughters. In order to give birth to good sons and daughters, the couple must become completely one. Without becoming one, good sons and daughters will not appear. Therefore, they must become completely one, centered on the Will of God. (Vol. 71, p. 19)
questions: If I had a rule of conduct for following God, what would it be?
Do I know the tradition of True Parents? What tradition must I transform into practical life?
Does following the path of tradition come first, or does the path through one’s spouse and children come first?
What do I think is the path of tradition that I can leave for my family and my children?
Do I think that everything in me and in my life is moving forward centered on the Will of God?

title: WHAT A PERSON OF FAITH MUST FEAR
reading: Even in the difficult course of Noah, who built the ark over the course of 120 years, on the day when the moment arrived for God to fulfill His desire, the command, “Enter the ark!” was given in a single instant. Those who obeyed that command were able to receive God’s eternal blessing, but those who did not were buried within the realm of eternal judgment. The same happened with Abraham. God blessed him, saying: “Your descendants shall multiply like the stars of heaven and like the sand on the seashore, and they shall remain even after covering all nations.” However, this command of blessing was also given in a single instant. The time when Abraham offered the sacrifice was not a period of several decades, but only one day. The time to divide the sacrifices and offer them was less than one hour; nevertheless, from that moment sprang forth the historical origin of all restoration of life. Today, what people of faith must fear is not the judgment that will come at the end, but the question of how to align with the Will the time that comes within the sphere of each day’s life, and how to form and move forward by creating an intersection together with the Will. (37-219, 1970.12.27)
questions: If entering the ark was Noah’s desire for 120 years, what is the desire in my daily life?
At each moment, on what basis do I judge and make decisions?
In my daily routine, is there a moment of judgment for me? If so, when is it?
How should I train myself so that, at each moment, my decisions are aligned with the Will?

title: WHAT HAPPENS WHEN WE GO TO THE SPIRITUAL WORLD?
reading: We becomes the body of God. The human being becomes the body of God. As it is recorded in John and in 1 Corinthians: “Do you not know that you have become the temple of God?” The human being is the house, the temple where God can dwell. How do we become similar to God? When we attain and make one with Him through the perfection of the Portion of Responsibility, with God acting, then, through love, we are embraced and the unity of life is realized. Life comes to be in harmony. The fact that man and woman form a family and a couple means that, centered on love, they become one and enter into harmony. In the same way, the power of this love enters into harmony with God. The human being possesses body and mind; above the mind is the spirit, and above the spirit is God. Therefore, the human being only becomes a perfect person when he becomes completely one with God. Although the human being is a small individual entity, he represents all of history and all future relationships; therefore, he possesses cosmic value. Will you live eternally on earth, or will you live eternally in the substantial world of invisible love? We can say that we will live eternally in the world that has become the substance of invisible love. When God wishes to reveal the Spiritual World, will He be able to manifest Himself through your body? Therefore, a spiritual body is necessary. This is not imagination, but fact. If there is a God who is the center of the invisible spirit, and if this God needs a reciprocal existence, then He will take the human being and desire to show and give all the eternal ideal kingdoms that He created. (Cheon Seong Gyeong, pp. 708–709)
questions: Have I ever been the temple of God?
Have I ever completed the responsibility given to me and directly received the love of God?
What must I do so that my love may represent the love of God?
Am I someone who can live eternally together with God?

title: WHAT IS THE FALL?
reading: The Fall is not knowing Heaven, not knowing the Earth, not knowing God, and not knowing people. The Fall occurred because Heaven and Earth were not known, people were not known, God was not known, and because a love centered on the human being was practiced. Therefore, a society in which immorality spreads will perish. The archangel and Eve united and ruined the husband. The Fall happened because man and woman separated, and Adam and Eve became enemies. Among sins, the most serious is the sin of destroying the love of God. We must know this heavenly principle. Clearly, Adam failed to fulfill the role of elder brother, and Eve failed to fulfill the role of younger sister. When the archangel seduced her, Eve should have asked Adam, and Adam should have consulted God. However, they judged on their own and followed the path of the Fall. The Fall means that Adam and Eve, centered on God, should have become one, but instead became one with the archangel, who was God’s servant. The human being, who should have inherited God’s lineage, inherited the lineage of a servant. For this reason, no matter how much the fallen human being calls God Father, he does not truly feel this in a real way. This happened because the primary characteristics of the fallen nature were inherited, causing people to think and connect all things only centered on themselves, without caring whether it is God or not. Thus, all became conflicting beings and formed tribes and peoples; and if things go just a little further, everything will end up being divided. What was established in this way is the cultural sphere of Satan. Dividing into two, dividing into three, and all separation belong to the sphere of Satan. God has been guiding the providence of unification in order to transform the divided cultural spheres into one. Every human being seeks the original nature of belonging to the central existence of the universe. However, because the central existence of this world is not God but Satan, the more one seeks the center, instead of becoming happy, a miserable history unfolds that makes the person unhappy. (Blessed Family and the Ideal Kingdom of Heaven, p. 324)
questions: Have I ever truly felt that I am a fallen descendant before God?
Can I distinguish whether I am a person of love centered on God or of love centered on the human being?
Have I ever felt that God is a Father more direct than my physical parents?
Let us think about the Primary Characteristics of the Fallen Nature that I possess.

title: THE EXISTENCE OF SATAN
reading: We know that God exists, and we also know that Satan exists, opposing God. What kind of existence is Satan? In the course of history, among sinners, he is the greatest sinner. In the course of history, he is the greatest sinner and also a monster. Until now, for six thousand years, Satan has opposed God, who has been guiding His providence. For six thousand years, he has opposed Him without missing even a single day, and at this very moment he is also opposing Him. No matter how weak and miserable human beings may be, in their hearts they think of following Heaven. They are thinking of goodness. However, Satan tries to destroy even that human heart. Because Satan has opposed the history of Heaven in this way, the entire world has become his stage, and at the same time, even you yourselves have become Satan’s stage. (Cheon Seong Gyeong, p. 591)
questions: Can I know and feel the existence of Satan?
Within a satanic environment, to what extent do I have a determined heart to move toward God?
Where do I think I stand, between God and Satan?
Let us talk about the experience of being in a state free from Satan.

title: THE METHOD OF INDEMNITY FOR RESTORATION
reading: After the Fall, everything, from the individual to the family, tribe, people, nation, and world, became the kingdom of Satan. How can this world be restored? It is by taking the individual as the center and sowing him here and there, separately. One must pull in the opposite direction and come out. One must escape. For this reason, in high-level religions, such as the Catholic Church, celibacy is practiced. And one must not love one’s mother and father, nor love one’s brothers and sisters. The biblical words, “He who loves his parents or brothers more than me cannot be my disciple,” may seem like paradoxical logic, but they must be accepted as the logic of the Principle in order to find the path of Heaven. Therefore, Father, in the midst of this earthly world, knowing this method of indemnity, has been adjusting the focus of love, beginning from the individual; then, the focus of family love, tribal love, the love of a people, and national love. Each time this happens, Satan uses all his strength to destroy it. Therefore, religion follows the path of persecution. One must not follow the path that society considers good. Tears and blood must be shed. One must not climb to the top. That is a safe zone. Because Satan is arrogant, the most miserable place is the safe zone. (181-212, 1988.10.03, p. 827)
questions: How often do I receive Satan’s dominion and create conditions through which Satan can find me?
What is the reason for and result of having faith before Satan?
What is the path for me not to give conditions to Satan?
Let us think about the method of indemnity by which I am led and the method of indemnity that I myself follow.

title: OTHER-CENTERED CONSCIENCE AND SELF-CENTERED CONSCIENCE
reading:
In the actual situation of human beings, words such as sin, evil, the Fall, and so on cannot be excluded. In other words, the phenomenon in which good and evil coexist is always taking place in the sphere of our lives. Naturally, there are religions that do not emphasize the distinction between good and evil, but True Parents, following the doctrine of original sin in Christianity, emphasized good and evil. In the Divine Principle, it is explained that the Fall of the first human ancestors, Adam and Eve, occurred because they had an improper relationship with the archangel. However, in another way, this has also been explained through the terms “other-centered conscience” and “self-centered conscience.” The first human ancestors, Adam and Eve, as well as the angels and archangels, were born as beings destined to live by receiving guidance according to the will of the Creator, the Heavenly Parents. This is called other-centered conscience. In other words, without the consciousness of “I” or “myself,” they were meant to live only in obedience, following the will of Heaven, in a state of unity between God and human beings. (Collected Sermons, Vol. 512, p. 29)

However, Lucifer, the archangel represented by the serpent, without any consultation or question to the Heavenly Parents, made a non-principled judgment centered on himself in order to dominate human beings and all things. This desire was transmitted to Eve and Adam. The first human ancestors made the mistake of judging by themselves, listening to Satan’s voice. This is self-centered conscience. It is acting on one’s own, without consulting the Creator, the Heavenly Parents. Naturally, Satan skillfully seduced them to act in this way and dragged them away with deceptive words. The loss of other- centered conscience caused the nature of the Fall. Therefore, on the path of faith, a posture of absolute obedience, absolute submission, absolute service, and absolute attendance is required. Each person always passes through moments in which they must judge some important matter. In those moments, a posture of other-centered conscience is necessary. Satan has dominated human beings by making them listen to their own voice, taking possession of the spiritual vision of the spiritual body and the physical vision of the physical body. Human beings left the position of children of the Heavenly Parents and ended up becoming children of Satan. For this reason, within human beings, the original nature of creation, with its good character, and evil character are confused and mixed together. To purify this, a posture of fasting, suffering, abstinence, prayer, and study of the Word is necessary. (Vol. 41, p. 25)
questions: Does the voice within me come from God or from Satan?
What can I do to leave behind the habit of self-centered conscience and attain other- centered conscience?
Can I know and practice the will of Heaven for the sake of other-centered conscience?
How are the path of indemnity and the path of other-centered conscience connected?

title: ON GOD’S SIDE OR SATAN’S SIDE?
reading: Whose side are you on? Are you on God’s side or on Satan’s side? You are on God’s side, but you have not yet become people of God. Before entering the center, you are only on the side. A side is something that simply has to cross the dividing line. Are you close to the center? Have you only barely crossed the dividing line? Or are you on both sides? If there is still attachment to the love of Satan’s world, you will end up passing over to that side immediately. From today, you must pass one hundred percent to God’s side. If you have not passed one hundred percent to God’s side, but only seventy or thirty percent, and if you can pass one hundred percent by cutting off one leg, then have the determination to cut off that leg. In this way, you will be able to place yourselves completely, one hundred percent, in the center of the Unification Church. You yourselves know well how many percent you have passed. There is no need for explanation. The heart knows everything. The heart is God. Since you have heart, you can find the Kingdom of God. Now you have understood. Then, where will you go now? Will you go to the kingdom of Satan or to the Kingdom of Heaven? How will you go to the place where you are going? You must overcome Satan’s world. Without overcoming it, you will not be able to enter Paradise. To overcome Satan’s world, you cannot follow a comfortable path. Only by passing through a miserable and painful path can victory be attained. Many people say: “Why must I follow this path? Life is short, so would it not be better to live comfortably? Sometimes, is it not necessary to be morally correct?” However, you must overcome Satan’s world and move forward. Even if an individual, representing Satan’s world, comes to attack you, you must fight against that individual and overcome him; even if a family, representing Satan’s world, comes to attack, you must fight against that family and overcome it; and even if a nation or the world, representing Satan’s world, comes to attack, you must fight and overcome it. You must be able to say: “Let the individual champion of Satan’s world, the family champion, and the national champion appear; come and face me.” (1984.1.15, Belvedere Training)
questions: Am I on God’s side or on Satan’s side?
Am I on God’s side, or am I a person of God?
Is there still any attachment that remains in Satan’s world? What are they?
Is there within me a foundation to become a person of God? How can I hand it over to Satan?

title: INDEMNITY AND OFFERING
reading:
Who offers the offering? The people who say they will be saved, the people who say they will return to God, are the ones who offer the offering. They offer the offering in place of their own body. In this way, God, the offering, and I—the three—must become one. There must be no distance between them. (274-199~200, 1995.11.03)

In our course of faith, the Principle is, without fail, to restore through indemnity. And we learn that, in order to pay indemnity, an offering is absolutely necessary. What is this offering? It is a condition offered in place of my entire being. In other words, if I am internal, the offering is external; therefore, if what is external and what is internal do not become one, it is of no use. (67-113, 1973.05.27)

The offering and the person who offers it are not separate. Through heart, they are one. In other words, the offering must be an object loved by the person. It cannot be something that the person does not love. The beloved object must, at the same time, represent the position of substituting for that person’s blood and flesh. This is the offering. Therefore, the offering is what is most precious to that person. You must know that something like this can become an offering. (47-285, 1971.08.30)
questions: What kind of indemnity condition do I need in order to receive salvation?
What is the offering that enables me to move forward before Heaven?
Let us think about an experience in which God, the offering, and I become completely one.

title: TO GO TO THE KINGDOM OF HEAVEN, WE MUST RECEIVE SATAN’S CERTIFICATE
reading:
Jesus received the inheritance of the Kingdom of Heaven, but the world did not receive it. Then, who inherited the world? Cain inherited it. Therefore, the world is Cain’s kingdom. For this reason, Abel, after inheriting the Kingdom of Heaven, must receive the certificate guaranteed by Cain, who belongs to the world. To go to the Kingdom of Heaven, one must receive Satan’s certificate. The fallen human being is bound by these two principles. Because human beings have not been liberated from them, the history of six thousand years until now has continued to repeat itself in cycles, biting its own tail. However, now we understand this. In the Bible, there is the word: “You shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free” (John 8:32). Since we now understand, we must love, even while knowing this. To what extent must we love? We must love even Cain, who is our enemy. (Vol. 34, p. 278)

Even if someone attends church for one hundred years, if they go with a heart centered on themselves, they cannot go to the Kingdom of Heaven. They cannot receive salvation. One must know what religion is the true religion, what kind of person is a true person, and what kind of nation is a true nation. (78-118)
questions: Am I Abel or Cain?
What is Satan’s certificate that I must receive?
Have I received salvation? If so, how can I prove it?
Can I enter the Kingdom of Heaven? With what do I enter the Kingdom of Heaven?

title: JUDGMENT BY THE WORD
reading:
In the Principle, there are three great judgments. They are the judgment of truth, the judgment of character, and the judgment of heart. The Fall violated these three great conditions. I am going through this and teaching you. The path of restoration must be taught only after the person himself has first fulfilled it. This is because the Principle exists here. Since the faith of the parents was not established, and since the parents did not know first, what must be known must also first be known by the parents. Since the parents do not practice first, what must be practiced must also first be practiced by the parents. Therefore, if the Principle has not been established within myself as the standard that has already fulfilled these things, it cannot be taught. You must pass through the Principle. You must pass through the Principle and become people who are not bound by the standard of the Principle. In this way, you must become the substance of the Principle. The substantial restoration of a person who violates the rule of indemnity cannot be accomplished. If conditions of this kind remain, Satan will always drag that person away, saying: “This one is mine.” Therefore, in order to establish the substantial standard, one must face Satan directly and overcome him. (1973.07.08)

Furthermore, after you come to know, what must you do? Is it enough simply to know and observe? You must practice. You must experience it for yourselves and practice it. In order to practice according to the Word of the Principle, you must have conviction in the Principle. Then, upon hearing this Word of the Principle, what should you do? Because True Parents first practiced the Principle centered on body and mind, it became the law. Therefore, the children must also practice centered on the Word of the Principle. (1969.11.10)

What is True Love? Body and mind must become one. How can they become one? Satan’s lineage must be cut off. The root must be pulled out. This is religious life. It is spiritual practice. Therefore, centered on the mind, the body is formed into unity. It is to strike the body and strengthen the mind, making the body follow the mind. The conscience already knows that it must go to the Kingdom of Heaven. If, with the body, we separate Satan, we will naturally be divided. This is how it is when practicing True Love. (260-186)
questions: Let us think about the path to pass through the judgment of truth, that is, of the Word.
What must I do in order to pass through the judgment of character?
What is the content of the judgment of heart?

title: DEFENSE BASED ON CONDITIONS
reading:
Even God, who is the King, if He is caught by Satan’s accusations, cannot act, can He? Even the president of a country is like this. If he is caught by some condition and the people come to protest, what happens? Can he do anything? If one is caught by a condition, even God, who is omnipotent and omniscient, cannot act. If even a minister is caught by a condition, in just one day his head becomes completely confused. Therefore, it is necessary to carry out a defense based on conditions. The question of how to carry out defense based on conditions is an extremely difficult problem in the life of faith. Here, a matter of life or death is involved. (76-59, 1975.1.26)

We, human beings, are connected to the love of Satan, to the life of Satan, and to the lineage of Satan. This is the problem. In such a position, God cannot be present. God cannot interfere. From the beginning of history until now, why did God, who is omnipotent and omniscient, become an impotent God? When Satan placed himself in the position of an enemy, what did that enemy take? He took the love of God. He took the sphere of God’s love, the sphere of God’s life, and the sphere of God’s lineage. We must always carry this concept. (206-237, 1990.10.14)

Originally, Satan was the archangel. However, that archangel says: “I fell and became Satan, but God is the Absolute Being, omnipotent and omniscient; therefore, should the Lord not resolve this centered on the law He established? Even though I violated the law and became Satan, since God is absolutely omnipotent and omniscient, should the Lord not act centered on the law He established?” This is what he says. (Vol. 39, p. 88)
questions: Does Satan have any condition against me? What would it be?
What is the condition by which I cannot deny Satan or drive him away?
Let us think of a way to allow God to intervene between Satan and me.
What is the path for me to establish conditions in advance and defend myself from Satan?

title: FAITH WITH DEEP EXPERIENCES
reading: 10. A life of faith is to have deep experiences. If there are no deep experiences, one cannot know what it is. Therefore, one must experience it deeply. It is not simply experience, but deep experience. What is deep experience? When Heaven is sad, I must know that sadness. To feel that sadness reaching me is such a deep experience. When one experiences it deeply, there is no need for prayer. 11. In faith, what is most precious are deep experiences. When you experience deeply, you must shed endless tears, tears that even you yourselves cannot understand. You must shed tears that are so deep they transcend consciousness. It is not a matter of becoming angry and resentful because someone insulted you. A tragic heart, which even you yourselves cannot understand, must surround you, and endless tears must fall. The essential situation of the life of a person of faith must be like this. A suffering that even you yourselves do not know must penetrate deeply. It must penetrate so deeply that your chest feels tight and you do not know where to place your body. 12. By living a faith with deep experiences through the course of our life, you must walk the course of the Principle of separation and establish, before all creation, a standard by which you can lift your head as victorious ones who govern all things and represent eternity. If you do not establish such a standard, conditions of sadness will remain upon this earth. In addition, as long as the conditions of sadness continue, even if you go to Heaven, it will be difficult to seek the inner heart of God. Therefore, you must appear as substantial beings of God’s glory, as bodies of life through the heart of Jesus, and as bodies of the Holy Spirit. Only then will you become substantial beings of faith. (The Path of God’s Will, Chapter on “Faith”)
questions: Let us explain whether I have already deeply experienced the heart of God or of True Parents.
Why do tears and sobbing arise when we deeply experience the heart?
What must I do in order to deeply experience the heart of God?

title: EVIL IS BEING CENTERED ON ONESELF
reading: Evil is being centered on oneself, and good is placing oneself in a reciprocal position before the Creator, who is the Absolute Being. Therefore, just as we must look toward a great purpose and move forward in the direction of that great purpose, we must not be dominated by small purposes. Evil clings to every place it passes through. However, evil does not persevere. Evil acts skillfully. You must know this well. Therefore, the problem is to remove evil. Then, where is the homeland of evil, the place where evil was born? Where is the base of evil, and where is the homeland of evil? The homeland of evil is not the Republic of Korea. Nor is it the land of any country. Nor is it an organization to which some signboard has been attached. What makes up the Republic of Korea are individuals and families. The world is formed by the union of countless tribes, peoples, and nations. However, the homeland of evil is not that kind of family, tribe, nation, or world. Then, where is the homeland of evil? It is precisely within the human being. The homeland of evil, the base of evil, is precisely the human being. Do you understand? It is “us.” (Collected Sermons, Vol. 16, “The Purpose of Judgment,” 1966.1.2, pp. 112–113)
questions: What is my standard concerning good and evil? Can I accurately distinguish good from evil?
How are good and evil fighting within me?
Can I free myself from evil?
What is the method to protect goodness and move forward?

title: SATAN’S LOVE
reading: The fundamental reason why Satan became Satan was fallen love. Therefore, love became the most powerful weapon used by Satan. Satan always surrounds people and tempts them with momentary love. On the outside, it seems sweet, but this love does not last long and, in the end, it brings a person down. In this love, there is no responsibility, sacrifice, or true life. However, the love of Heaven is completely different. The love of Heaven is revealed through sacrifice and, through that sacrifice, produces beautiful and good fruits. Satan’s love is, in the end, a love that cannot be trusted and can only collapse; but the love of Heaven is the True Love that does not change and continues eternally. Therefore, in order to overcome Satan, we must not simply avoid evil; we must arm ourselves with the love of Heaven, which is greater, deeper, and more just. Only this love can overcome all the false loves of Satan and bring true life and victory. (Judgment by the Word of God)
questions: Within myself, can I distinguish between the love of God and the love used by Satan?
What kind of life can I live when I make the love of God my own?
Is there a way to avoid and overcome Satan’s love?
What is the method for my love and the fruits of my life to advance before God?

title: I MUST BECOME SOMEONE WHO DESIRES TO ENTER THE FURNACE UNTIL I BECOME PURE GOLD
reading: What you possess is twenty-four-karat gold, but it is twenty-four-karat gold that is inside sand, inside some ore, or inside mud. Therefore, it is necessary to place all of this into the furnace and melt it. It must be separated. This is the standard process. Then, when the body melts and disappears like water, what will you say? “Ah, how good!”? Or will you say: “Oh, I will die, I will die!” and make a great fuss? Even if all of this dies, the twenty-four-karat gold does not die. In order for you to become pure, you cannot fail to deny even 98%. What is ours is only 2%. Then, what must we do? Is this not extremely miserable? Think about whether the life of the Moonies is miserable or happy. Then, is Reverend Moon, who is the center of the Moonies, happy or miserable? Even if at the beginning it is unhappy, afterward there is hope of becoming happy. When we suffer persecution, we enter the furnace. We think: “This happens because I am still incomplete.” If persecution comes, let it come. If it is possible to suffer persecution, then let me suffer it. I must desire to enter the furnace until I become pure gold. This is the fastest method to become pure gold. Therefore, in order to abandon the 98% and follow the path to become 100% pure gold, how much patience will a person need? How deep will the suffering be? Even so, one must have the conviction that one must follow this path. (Vol. 128, p. 206)
questions: What is the meaning of walking the path in a pure way?
What must I deny and burn in the furnace?
At this moment, do I think I am happy or unhappy?
Let us think about the path for me to become pure gold before God.

title: THE ORIGINAL PATH WE MUST FOLLOW BY KNOWING TRUE PARENTS
reading:
Even if you have passed through the desert and crossed the Jordan River, if you fall on the path of fighting against the seven tribes of Canaan, it will not be a victorious death. After subjugating the seven tribes of Canaan, you must establish the new nation of Israel there; only then will you become the original people who can receive establishment before God. Otherwise, it will be the same as remaining in paradise. It means that you will not be able to enter the Kingdom of Heaven. (13-298, 1964.4.12)

Who are the True Parents whom we know? They are the human ancestors, the ancestors of humanity. Therefore, we must serve True Parents as we serve our own parents. (118-147, 1982.5.23)

When we look centered on the number three, one cannot help but serve for more than three years. Therefore, the principle is to live for three years centered on one’s parents: eating together, talking together, and living together. Your family must be like this. There must be a period of three years in which, as a family that lives attending the parents, you live peacefully and happily, speaking only good words and rejoicing with one another. (Vol. 44, p. 170)
questions: Let us think about the concept of and the difference between paradise and the Kingdom of Heaven.
What kind of relationship exists between me and True Parents?
What kind of life is a life of attendance? What can I do in order to attend True Parents?

Let us think about the content that, in the Old Testament Age, a person was justified by works; in the New Testament Age, justification was sought through faith; and in the Completed Testament Age, one receives justification through attendance.

title: LEARN THE LANGUAGE OF TRUE PARENTS
reading:
Above all, language is the greatest problem. When Koreans come, those who do not know Korean are truly blocked. It is pitiful. Then, how wonderful would it be if language became one? I also, when I first went to the United States, studied through books, but I only knew how to say “yes” and “no.” So how frustrating must that have been? You will understand how necessary the unity of language is. Do you want to hear my words through translation, or do you want to hear them directly from me? You want to hear them in Korean. Why? Because Korean is the original language. Therefore, in the study of the Principle, if you do not know the original language, you will not know its true meaning. And in the future, when you go to the Spiritual World, will it be a source of pride to say, “I lived simply by listening to Father’s words”? Or will it be a source of pride to say, “I spoke and listened through translation”? Which of the two? Moreover, words express the ideal world of love. If we set translation aside and whisper the word “love,” will it be understood? When we look at the pledge we memorized before, in the fifth item it is written: “To take pride in one unified culture.” The problem is how this one culture will become reality. You must know that, in the world of heart, one cannot become one without this. Those who truly desire one world of heart cannot be unaware of this. When I go to you and touch you like this, saying, “I love you very much,” my legs move even before I think about how you will perceive that love. The legs come first; the thought of love does not. How foolish! Using food as an analogy, it is like eating leftovers and finding joy in them. Without the tradition and spirit of the ideal family, the ideal world cannot manifest. (Vol. 118, p. 238)

NOTAS NOTAS NOTAS NOTAS NOTAS NOTAS
questions: How are communication through language and spiritual communication different?
Why must we learn Korean?
In the Spiritual World, how will we communicate and have exchange with True Parents?
How does a community of heart act and maintain itself?
